title: Directionally Correct Views in Portfolio Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.31074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio optimization techniques often use historical data to estimate parameters for Markowitz-type or ML models. Effective allocation requires a way to align the available data with conditions expected over the investment horizon. Inspired by the Black-Litterman framework, we ask whether incorporating expert views leads to better portfolio allocations. In a simple Markowitz setting, we show that even a small amount of directionally correct information can materially improve investment decisions. We also discuss how expert views can be incorporated in end-to-end portfolio models using entropy-based ideas. Somewhat surprisingly, our empirical results indicate that simpler Markowitz-type model perform as well as an end-to-end model, once directionally correct experts are incorporated.

translated_title: 投资组合优化中方向正确的专家观点
translated_abstract: 投资组合优化技术通常使用历史数据来估计Markowitz类型或机器学习模型的参数。有效的资产配置需要一种方法将可用数据与投资期限内的预期条件相对齐。受Black-Litterman框架的启发，我们探究引入专家观点是否能带来更好的投资组合配置。在一个简单的Markowitz设定中，我们证明了即使是少量的方向正确的信息也能实质性改善投资决策。我们还讨论了如何使用基于熵的方法将专家观点整合到端到端投资组合模型中。有些令人惊讶的是，我们的实证结果表明，一旦纳入方向正确的专家观点，更简单的Markowitz类型模型的表现可与端到端模型相当。
tldr: 受Black-Litterman框架启发，本文证明即使是少量的方向正确的专家观点也能显著改善投资组合优化决策，且一旦纳入此类观点，简单的Markowitz模型表现可与端到端模型媲美。
en_tdlr: Inspired by the Black-Litterman framework, this paper shows that even a small amount of directionally correct expert views can materially improve portfolio allocation decisions, and once such views are incorporated, simpler Markowitz-type models perform as well as end-to-end models.
